Application Data.NAME: Paws & Claws Veterinary Clinic
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Paws & Claws Veterinary Clinic offers a wide range of veterinary services, including routine check-ups, vaccinations, emergency care, and surgical procedures for pets. Our facility is equipped with advanced medical technology to ensure high-quality care. We also provide grooming services and pet wellness programs to promote overall health. Our team of experienced veterinarians and support staff is dedicated to the well-being of every animal that visits our clinic. Additionally, we focus on educating pet owners about responsible pet ownership and preventive healthcare measures.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 02/15/2022, a fire incident occurred due to faulty electrical wiring, resulting in damage to medical equipment and clinic interior. Total loss estimated at $10,000. Status: Closed. On 05/10/2023, a liability claim was filed after a pet escaped and caused a minor injury to a customer. Total loss of $2,500. Status: Open.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade II, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Metal fencing and 24-hour monitored alarm system

Sample Reviews: The veterinary staff were knowledgeable and attentive, providing thorough care for my pet during the visit.

I took my dog to this veterinary clinic hoping for compassionate care, but I was sorely disappointed. The staff seemed disinterested and rushed, leading to a lack of thoroughness in the examination. Additionally, my dog's follow-up treatment was poorly communicated, leaving me confused and frustrated about the next steps for his recovery.

I recently took my dog to Paws & Claws Veterinary Services and was thoroughly impressed with their compassionate care and professionalism. The staff was attentive to my pet's needs and took the time to explain every procedure, ensuring I felt comfortable throughout the visit. I did notice the clinic's location poses some challenges, such as the problematic distance to the nearest fire hydrant according to their logistics, but that in no way detracted from the excellent service they provide!
